# ENDOCARDITIS WITH ENTEROCOCCI

Infectious diseases and cardiology should be consulted in all cases

# Duration of therapy

Native valve endocarditis (NVE):

Duration of therapy depends on duration of symptoms, susceptibility of the
enterococcus isolate to antimicrobials, and the effectiveness of the
antimicrobials that can be used. For patients who have experienced symptoms for
less than 3 months and who can be treated with ampicillin or penicillin plus
gentamicin, treat for 4. Treat all other patients including any patient
receiving vancomycin for at least 6 weeks. Duration should be determined with
input from Infectious Diseases.

Prosthetic Valve endocarditis (PVE):

Treat for at least 6 weeks, duration should be determined with input from
Infectious Diseases.

References:

Fernandez-Hidalgo, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2013, 56: 1261

Therapy:
## Organism Susceptibility

## Isolate is susceptible to penicillin (MIC </= 16 mcg/mL) and high concentration

## gentamicin (MIC </= 500 mcg/mL)

[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R < AND > ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) for 6](orz-set-abx-ampicil-2gm-iv-q4h-ceftriaxone-2g-q12h)

weeks
< OR >
[Penicillin G 4 MU IV q4h \($$\) R < AND > gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q8h \($\)](orz-set-abx-penicil-4mu-iv-q4h-gent-1mg-kg-iv-q8h)

[R,O] for 4 to 6 weeks (NVE) for 6 weeks (PVE)

< OR >
[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R < AND > gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q8h \($\) R,O](orz-set-abx-ampici-2gm-iv-q4h-gent-1mg-kg-iv-q8h)

for 4 to 6 weeks (NVE) for 6 weeks (PVE)

## Isolate is resistant to gentamicin (MIC > 500 mcg/mL)

[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R < AND > ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) for 6](orz-set-abx-ampicil-2gm-iv-q4h-ceftriaxone-2g-q12h)

weeks

## Isolate is penicillin-resistant (MIC > 16 mcg/mL)

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R < AND > gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q8h \($\)](orz-set-abx-vanc-q12h-15mg-kg-gent-1mg-kg-iv-q8h)

[R,O] for 6 weeks

## Isolate is penicillin resistant (MIC > 16 mcg/mL), gentamicin resistant (MIC >

## 500 mcg/mL) and vancomycin resistant

[Linezolid 600 mg IV q12h \($$$$\) DI for 6 weeks](psjizid-linezolid-600mg-iv-q12h)

< OR >
[Daptomycin 10-12 mg/kg IV q24h \($$$$\) R,DI for 6 weeks](psjizid-daptomycin-10-12mg-kg-q24h)
